# Victor Romanov

> AI Solutions Architect and Delivery Lead. Enterprise AI, LLM and RAG, cloud and data-center migration, technical proposals and presales. Fractional AI Architect or CTO. Remote worldwide, open to relocation.

## Profile

- Designs AI and infrastructure solutions and leads delivery from the technical proposal to production.
- Built the IT function of a major commercial bank from scratch and led a team of about 90 people.
- Own IT integration consultancy since 2013: 93 delivered projects, peak annual turnover exceeding $2.4M.
- Project types: data-center migration, CCTV, access control, fire alarm, seamless WiFi, data-center power.
- Founder and AI Solution Architect of TenderSRB, a working multi-tenant AI SaaS for public-procurement monitoring, built with AI and running on AI agents.
